No concrete regression is independently supported by the replayed source. These changes concern CI routing and recovery rather than provider plaintext handling, X25519 custody, cache isolation or serving authorization (A-001, A-003, T-041, TB-011/T-053/T-054). The CI watchdog is distinct from the provider rollback mechanism in T-043. Its repository-wide cancellation/retry authority is security-relevant new infrastructure surface, but the workflow implementation is omitted from this incomplete replay; the prior analysis cannot substitute for source verification.

Further review must inspect .github/workflows/darkbloom-watchdog.yml, particularly the reported API scoping and runner selection at lines 90-101 and 228-274, retry behavior at 155-176, and marker recovery at 191-212 and 265-277. Resolve whether retry reliably selects fallback and whether cancellation conflicts can later resurrect intentionally cancelled runs. These remain unverified contracts, not findings: neither the missing workflow source nor the external routing implementation establishes a regression.
